subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to share the details of our upcoming travel itinerary for our business trip next week. We will be flying out on Monday morning and returning on Friday evening. I have attached a copy of the flight and hotel reservations for your reference. Looking forward to a successful trip! Please let me know if you have any questions. Best regards, [Your Name]
